1.0.0-rc.24.blurb: More to do, new bounties and your pack version in Settings. Update your server and clients together.
lines: 35 new optional Journal quests, from building to End alchemy
Five new bounties: honey, long-range skeletons, trident hits, curing a zombie villager and piglin barters
Personal Settings shows which pack version you’re on
Cave spiders count wherever spider kills count
New ways through Tools tiers: craft a smithing table, put on an armor trim or cure a villager

1.0.0-rc.26.blurb: Shields sooner, less Gold grinding and fish in buckets. Update your server and clients together.
lines: Shields craft and work as soon as you reach Iron Armor
Gold Tools asks for less mining, digging and woodcutting
Iron Tools has you catch four kinds of fish in buckets instead of 24 on a rod
A simpler Journal: task titles and progress, nothing extra
New Prism setups are named Minecraft - Progression Survival
